title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Italian Twist
description: A unique fusion of Italian and Moroccan flavors, this chicken tagine is a hearty and aromatic dish that combines the spices of Morocco with the rich flavors of Italy.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken breasts and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, Moroccan spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the tagine to the oven and cook at 375°F (190°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the tagine from the oven and stir in the crumbled fromage frais.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
